name: Wie is de Mol?
description: Ten candidates have to complete assignments to earn money. However, one of the group members is the Mole. The Mole's goal is to make the assignments fail and keep the amount of money earned as low as possible. The other candidates do not know who the Mole is and need to unmask them. At the end of every episode, the candidates take a multiple-choice test about the mole's identity. The person who gives the least amount of correct answers is "executed" and must leave. This process continues until only two contestants and the Mole remain. The winner is the person with the most correct answers in the final test and they get all of the money earned in previous stages of the game.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Rik van de Westelaken meets the ten contestants. For the first time since their adventure in Cambodia the ten of them are back as a group. How where the last few months of keeping everything a secret? Together they look back at their adventure, look ahead on what the coming season will bring and they'll give an exclusive view into their preperations and strategy. The ideal moment for the viewer to meet these ten contestants, and for the group it's the moment to watch the first sneak-peak of the season together..

videos.title: Phones, car wrecks and a symphony
Dilemmas and a kiss of death
Iets is wat het lijkt (Something is what it seems)
Lot in Eigen Handen (Fate in Own Hands)
Tand om Tand (Tooth for a Tooth)
Wie is de Mol? (Who is The Mole?)
De eerste 2 uur (The first 2 hours)
videos.overview: Art Rooijakkers takes the ten contestants to Iceland and immedeately sends them on a mission, on a big glacier. That's where the search for the mole, and the survival to stay in the game, starts in all it's intensity.

videos.title: In de min (In negative numbers)
videos.overview: In their search for the mole the contestants climb some stairs, drive in certain lines on a big plain of ash and try to communicate with smoke-signals.

videos.title: Geen Toneel (No Drama)
videos.overview: The dropout gets to enjoy a traditional Dutch game and some sight-seeing in Reykjavik before it's time to leave. The fact that the jokers just got introduced into this season are too late for him to make a difference...

videos.title: Iemand Anders (Someone Else)
videos.overview: The seven remaining contestants in the grim and chilly Iceland are still on the hunt for the mole in their midst. But hope is dawning: negotiations are in progress that could bring a bright future.

videos.title: Van achter naar voren (From the back to the front)
videos.overview: The season is on the halfway-point and its every man for themselves. Opponents are shoved out of the way without warning and for one of the contestants this will mean they'll have to leave the game. The fact that everyone has their own problems, becomes very clear for the remaining contestants.

videos.title: Rookgordijn (Smoke screen)
videos.overview: With only three eliminations to go until the finale it's becoming more and more important to give it all. Who is the mole? An exemption could help, but there are more sharks in the pont. A chaotic game gives some clarity.

videos.title: Zelfkennis (Self-knowledge)
videos.overview: The last five contestants are doing everything they can to find the mole. While only just gotten adjusted to the sun again, they have to pull out all the stops to bring in money. And some creativitiy is needed to bring back the great masters.

videos.title: Tim, Anne-Marie, Liesbeth (Tim, Anne-Marie, Liesbeth)
videos.overview: Who deserves the first spot in the finale? And who will drop out with the finish line in sight? But more important is the biggest question of all; who is the mole? Almost all these questions will be answered. Besides, a game of quartets has never been this exciting...

videos.title: Ja, Nee ... Nee, Ja (Yes, No ... No, Yes)
videos.overview: The last three contestents of this season get a big surprise when waking up on a haciënda. Will they be able to get in time to their biggest challenge thus far; the very last test that will decide both the loser and the winner of this season.

videos.title: Maar een in Spanje (Only one in Spain)
videos.overview: Who is the mole and what did this mole manage to pull of during this long adventure trough Iceland and the south of Spain? In this last episode everything becomes clear and all contestants finally get to see what sercets the mole has hidden from them.

videos.title: Het verlossende woord (The redeeming word)
videos.overview: The first episode of the thirteenth season of Who is the Mole? is a first encounter with South-Africa and all it's diversity. The contestants will ascend to great hights while possibly also descending into the depths. Whether this will bring in money for the pot all depends on their trust in their colleagues. Keeping in mind that there is a mole in their midst.

videos.title: Spiegelbeeld (Mirror image)
videos.overview: Is the African language easy to pick up, or complete gibberish for the contestants? And, are they going quicker than lightspeed? Both the pot as the contestants depend on it.

videos.title: Tunnelvisie (Tunnelvision)
videos.overview: This episode brings a whole new meaning to the fact that participating in Who is the Mole? feels like a jump in the deep end. And in the South-African jungle there is a procession of animals going on, including one mole...

videos.title: Anders dan anders (Different than usual)
videos.overview: The search for the mole continues. And doing this in South-Africa means you can't ignore the Big Five. So neither can the contestants of Who is the Mole?.

videos.title: Fluister en huiver (Whisper and shiver)
videos.overview: In their hunt for gold and the mole, the contestants discover that there's another mole in the mix. Luckily the mole will reveal themselves that evening.

videos.title: Horen, zien en zwijgen (Hear, see and hush)
videos.overview: The mole sends the contestants to new, wild terrain today, where they will get very close to the truth. Despite all that one of them gets sent home.

videos.title: Een ontwikkeling (A development)
videos.overview: Tunnelvision and blind confidence; two characteristics that are useless to a contestant. Fitness on the other hand could prove to be very usefull to stay in the game.

videos.title: In het kader van (In the context of)
videos.overview: The search is almost over. Only four contestants remain with one of them being the mole. The journey returns to the big city, where the shape of the mole becomes visable.

videos.title: Trust nobody (Trust nobody)
videos.overview: One winner, one loser and one mole. The question: who is who? The contestants try to find an answer to this question in the library of Johannesburg. Only to find this answer after boarding a steam train.

videos.title: Wie is de Mol? (Who is the Mole?)
videos.overview: The journey trough South-Africa is done. Back in the Netherlands all contestants meet one more time to see what the mole has been up to all season.

videos.title: A Clear Conscience
videos.overview: Bridget Maasland, Gabriël Martina, Maaike Martens, Nora Akachar, Ray Klaassens, Roos Moggré, Sam Hagens, Sophie Frankenmolen, Stijn de Vries and Teun Luijkx travel to Cambodia. The intense search for The Mole starts in the capitol city Phnom Penh. Who is trustworthy? And who isn't?

videos.title: The Right Motive
videos.overview:
The ten contestants know they have to focus now they have chosen The Mole themselves.

5 of them are still eligible for a joker. But wether they'll actually get them is still unclear.

videos.title: Fumbling in the dark
videos.overview: Bram Krikke, Daan Boom, Delilah Warcup-van Eyck, Eveline Stallaart, Geraldine Kemper, Matteo van der Grijn, Milan van Dongen, Nasrdin Dchar, Nienke van Dijk, and Quinty Misiedjan attempt to earn as much money as possible by completing challenges. The search begins in Manyara, where the candidates trek through pristine nature in jeeps. In the wilderness, among elephants, zebras, and giraffes, they must keep a cool head. Here too, a good start is half the battle. For on this safari, nothing is what it seems: who dares to trust their own intuition? And who makes the right decision? In this opening phase, the candidates know one thing for sure: every choice can be directly decisive for the continuation of their search.

videos.title: Through the eye of the needle
videos.overview: A player who has been eliminated is given the opportunity to return to the game. Mole tricks took place at the market and in the parking lot where the jeeps were parked. And then you buy a joker and you don't use it and you can ........ this happened to a candidate, so it wasn't very smart to do.

videos.title: Looking through different eyes
videos.overview: The candidates put on their sportswear to take on the Tanzanian team in an exciting football match. While the majority get ready for the kick-off, there are also two substitutes who head straight to a festively decorated living room filled with flags and festive decorations. A surprising role awaits them here: by playing a challenging bar game, they can hinder the opponents on the field by earning a ‘freeze’. This strategic move could completely turn the game around. Moreover, every goal scored earns the team a handsome reward of no less than €100.00. A combination of sporting competition, clever tactics, and a festive atmosphere makes this an unforgettable adventure.

videos.title: Follow blindly
videos.overview: With him in our alliance, we have a strong team. Being aware of your surroundings and paying attention to details are the key to this assignment. The Mole has distributed the maximum amount of €2,000.00 among the safes. Note the word ‘gas station’ – easier said than done. Using photos and a cryptic description, they must decipher the password. A maximum of two people are allowed on the field. Which safes are they going to open? Watch out for guards who can shoot you; you’ll lose your money immediately, and not everyone plays fair. There is also a telephone attached to a high silo, accessible via abseiling. At the lifelines, you can earn money and an advantage for the quiz, up to €4,000.00. And then comes the quiz: whoever scores the worst or spreads out their answers must leave the game.

videos.title: To look out of the corner of one eye
videos.overview:
Every cup of coffee costs a lot here; there is a name in Shawhill in the factory, and if you pick the right one, you earn 50 euros and must weigh exactly 20 kg. But sometimes the text makes absolutely no sense. The mole here is so naive as to make a perfect mistake at the coffee bean slide. Will that be noticed? And who will find the jokers? The search for jokers has taken a lot of time; it is not always Joker Day.

Welcome to this coffee plantation! Soon it will rain money, and you must try to grab it. Watch out for the guards, and a maximum of two people are allowed to enter the field. Make sure you are on time for the drone; there is a nice sum to be earned.

videos.title: To see through someone else's eyes
videos.overview: Yesterday, one of the participants received a secret assignment from the Mole. If successfully completed, this assignment yields €1,000.00, while the Mole will actively try to prevent money from entering the pot. The specific task involves a participant formulating four sentences containing the word “eye.” If this assignment is completed, the participant in question will receive two jokers, and the group will go home with zero euros. During the day, a walk is on the program, followed by participation in a traditional Maasai activity: carrying water. This challenge can yield €400.00. Next, there is a javelin throwing segment, where hitting the target is worth €150.00 per spear. Finally, the first two candidates to take a seat in the jeep will take the leap, bringing the tension of the day to a climax.

videos.title: Every pair of eyes counts
videos.overview: Welcome to Zanzibar. This is your bar, which must match the six photos provided exactly. You will receive €100.00 for every correct detail, but the Mole will naturally try to conceal these details. Everything is being removed and the details will be added later, although one ball is currently missing. Meanwhile, two others are performing an impressive high-altitude tandem jump while simultaneously having to memorize cocktails. Soon, you will be divided into three duos: in the first, one person must act out and the other guess; in the second, a duo chooses the music, though the songs are played backwards. Finally, Rik asks exam questions; answer these correctly and you will come face to face with the Mole. If all three questions are answered correctly, you will earn €200.00.

videos.title: See through
videos.overview: With Robbie Williams' 'Let Me Entertain You' playing in the background, the mole was given the perfect opportunity to fulfill their role. The energetic dance later transformed into an exhilarating African choreography, completely shifting the atmosphere. Next, the group moves to a theater filled with ordinary families to perform their show. The question remains: will the mole be able to subtly sabotage here, or will they allow money to be earned? The more enthusiastic the applause, the more money in the pot, but how will the audience react? Will it be exuberant, or will it remain very quiet? And then comes the dreaded test, the moment of truth. Who has to pack their bags and leave the game? The tension rises to unprecedented heights as everyone wonders who gets to play for one more round.

videos.title: Couldn't believe my eyes
videos.overview: Is the mole the treasurer? And then, what everyone had been hoping for: the shooting challenge. You can earn more than just money, because you get to view some mole diaries. To do so, however, you have to do something: stop the intruders. Then, the eliminated contestants appear incognito, dressed in animal costumes. Are you ready for the final safari? This is the very last chance to earn money and come face-to-face with the mole. And then there is that annoying test again. Who will be eliminated, just before the finale?

videos.title: Final
videos.overview: Back in the Netherlands, we have only one goal: to find out who screwed us over the most and who is walking away with the pot? And we are doing just that, old-fashioned, at this reunion.
